<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 121.05, which corresponds to a protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~120.05 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) suggests about eight carbon atoms. A formula that fits this mass and carbon count is C₈H₈O (exact neutral mass 120.0575 Da, [M+H]+ = 121.0648 Da), matching the observed data within experimental error. Therefore the molecular formula is C8H8O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H8O</final_answer>
